YOUR PROPOSED BUILD

Starting scopes for discussion. Final price, feasibility and acceptance criteria require a written proposal. No payment or build starts here.

01 / WHAT YOU RECEIVE

A defined handover.

Agreed source code and deployment configuration, workflow documentation, administrator access, account ownership and training. Ownership of custom deliverables is defined in the contract; third-party models, software and licenses retain their own terms.

02 / WHAT YOU KEEP PAYING

Usage, not a mandatory service retainer.

Budget for API consumption, hosting, domain renewal and any messaging, storage or other required third-party charges. We estimate them before build. Client-owned services are paid through your accounts; no Agenticcore maintenance subscription is required unless you choose one.

03 / KEEPING IT WORKING

Support you can choose.

The proposal defines a post-handover defect-fix period for the agreed scope. Optional maintenance can cover monitoring and updates. New features, provider changes and work outside that period are quoted or covered by a chosen support plan. Software needs ongoing upkeep; this is not a lifetime operation guarantee.

Four milestone payments, tied to progress.

25% at agreed scope and kickoff → 25% after prototype approval → 25% after integration testing → 25% at acceptance and handover. These are proposed build milestones, not weekly installments. Any scope change needs a revised quote before work continues.

MANAGED OFFICE / YOUR OFFICE, YOUR WAY

Choose the support.
Shape your office.

Choose departments and a work level. Explore a single managed package from $100 to $3,000 per service cycle. All figures and allowances below are proposals for review.

2. Choose the work level
One package. The delivery tools are on us.

Proposed package pricing includes Agenticcore-managed AI, standard production tools, coordination and agreed update-channel delivery within your allowance. You do not need separate AI API subscriptions for this managed work. Client-owned automation or special integrations are scoped before you commit.

Paid advertising spend is separate: you set and approve that budget. Any request outside the agreed package is quoted before work starts.

YOUR PROPOSED DIGITAL OFFICE

Planning estimate, not a checkout. No payment is taken and no services are activated.

Four payments. Room to adapt.

Each monthly-style office package covers a 28-day service cycle, payable upfront or in four weekly payments. A $200 cycle is $50 per week; a $1,000 cycle is $250 per week. A 28-day cycle is not a calendar month.

Proposed flexibility: change your departments or level at the next weekly boundary. Completed work and the current week keep their agreed price; the new weekly scope and charge are shown before you confirm. Future-week changes are not a commitment to the original four-payment total. Final cancellation and billing terms will be agreed before paid launch.

YOUR FIRST DAYS / A CLEAR START

From your idea.
To a working routine.

Your office starts with an agreed plan. Here is the proposed onboarding journey once connected services launch.

01 / CHOOSE & CONFIRM

Agree the first workload.

Choose departments, share example tasks and confirm outputs, allowances, revisions and turnaround with Maya. Managed plans use a 28-day cycle with four weekly payments; custom builds use four milestones.

02 / CONNECT & APPROVE

Give your office its instructions.

Amara gathers approved business facts, brand assets and authorized access. Choose your update channel and which actions need your approval. Connection feasibility is checked before work begins.

03 / DELIVER & REVIEW

See what actually happened.

Review the first delivery, track accepted tasks and receive an agreed activity summary. Reports distinguish completed work, pending approvals, failures and next steps. Delivery deadlines are confirmed per task.

This preview prepares a downloadable brief. Connected onboarding, payments and messaging are not active yet. Automated intake is planned around the clock; work follows agreed capacity and delivery times.
